Evangel was already in the graveyard before the Blade was sacrificed, so it must not trigger (701.21a: a sacrificed permanent is moved from the battlefield to its owner's graveyard; Evangel's own sacrifice is not "another"). Source (XMage 4142596, same in the gorge-sync fork tree): LightlessEvangel.java:41 uses SacrificePermanentTriggeredAbility, which sets setLeavesTheBattlefieldTrigger(true) (SacrificePermanentTriggeredAbility.java:43); AbilityImpl.isInUseableZone (AbilityImpl.java:1371) then treats a source in game.checkShortLivingLKI(id, BATTLEFIELD) as still on the battlefield for SACRIFICED_PERMANENT (isEventCanLookBackInTime, AbilityImpl.java:1434). lkiShortLiving is only cleared by resetShortLivingLKI at GameImpl.java:1881 (after the player's priority loop ends), :1894 (after a resolve) and in processAction (:2113).
